audit_items.proof_trace: The exchange rate formula `(cash + debt - cash_reserve) / total_supply` uses `self.cash`, which is intentionally NOT decremented during flash loan borrow — `flash_loan_withdraw` (L318-324) only touches `underlying_balance`, unlike `withdraw_underlying` which decrements `self.cash`. Fee repayment via `increase_reserve_only` adds `fee` to both `cash` and `cash_reserve` equally, so the numerator `cash+debt-cash_reserve` is unchanged. Algebraically, deposits during a flash loan also preserve the rate: depositing X yields exactly `X / exchange_rate` new cTokens, keeping rate constant.
